rules.supervised_training_data: All compared methods must use supervised labels from the target dataset train split only.
rules.split_manifest: All compared methods must share the same target-dataset train/valid/test participant manifest.
rules.standardization: All preprocessing statistics and calibration choices must be fit on training or validation data only, never on test.
rules.model_selection: Reference runs and strongest baselines are selected by validation primary metric, then reported on test.
